decisions: One bounded session, one executor, autonomous design frontier; no approval or new Work Request.
Choose one ownership module before decoding over a post-merge Python address filter. Root and mailbox keys are distinct.
Stream binding discovery and content passes; do not retain the entire inflated store.
Use owned-db so older installed decoders reject the command before source recovery. Delete unowned db export and folder output.
Reject other roots before mail/schema/conversation/copy/calendar effects. Keep all merged and inherited donor source offsets.
Disable sidecar recovery. Allowed inline content and previews remain functional.
Persist account namespace plus source snapshot digest, binding offsets and source IDs in requests, steps, saved replies, pending_full and refresh.
Validate state before replay and unchanged-store optimization. Hold unproven legacy state intact without acknowledgment or participant inference.
Keep original red baseline evidence immutable. New v2 tests exercise actual bounded binary fixtures and actual export schema plus fake external ports.
Keep do_not_merge and defer independent block/LZ/runtime qualification; no live intake, installation, deployment or merge.
